FEAT-6-S149.title: Consent API Endpoints & Service Contracts
FEAT-6-S149.description: Expose backend API endpoints for capturing, updating, and retrieving consent status, including tier escalation and enforcement hooks for downstream services.

FEAT-6-S150.title: Consent Enforcement in Tool Router
FEAT-6-S150.description: Integrate consent checks into tool_router to ensure that any tool invocation involving identifiable data is blocked or transformed unless appropriate consent tier is present.

FEAT-6-S151.title: Conversation Summarization & De-identification Pipeline
FEAT-6-S151.description: Implement core logic for summarizing conversations and applying HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification prior to storage when Tier 2 consent is not granted.

FEAT-6-S152.title: Lead Capture Consent Tier Integration
FEAT-6-S152.description: Ensure lead_capture service correctly enforces consent tiers by requiring Tier 2 consent for storing identifiable lead data and coordinating with ConsentService for validation.
